definitions.household_share: known positive households with valid year
definitions.complex_share: complexes with valid year, including unknown households

limits: Fixed currently retained inventory arithmetic, not future supply, demolition, reconstruction eligibility, price or trading predictions.
Canonical year and household priority are preserved. Unknown household totals are not imputed; legal housing, occupancy and parcel extent are not fully observed.
Annual entry is shown for provinces; regional comparisons show cumulative30+ stock at2026/2030/2035. Every comparison row is retained.
Counts are rounded to1000 households; shares to5pp; coverage in10pp bands. Withheld is not zero; rounded differences need not equal separately rounded entries.
Household shares exclude unknown household values; complex shares can include them. Subsets keep their own denominator and coverage.
No individual identities, exact private additive totals or denominators, contract events, prices or rental equations are added. Finite overlap review and full corpus replay are separate requirements.
